title: Wood is Wood
description: Makes all wood craft into Wooden Planks
body:
# Wood is Wood

Renames Oak Planks to "Wooden Planks". All wood types craft into Wooden Planks.

You can still get each wood type by stripping the logs.

![a GIF demo showing several wood types being crafted into Wooden Planks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/6EqiCpM0/images/f6c58a7c43435b7dc1cb8eb54333f79afb7e7caa.gif)
